violations.quote: has guaranteed fuel from Barrow Pusher
violations.rule: Barrow Pusher gives 1 Clay and 1 Food only for each new field tile gained. It does not guarantee Clay unless the player actually gains new fields.

violations.quote: The hand offers strong resource efficiency but no direct free-action or growth mechanism.
violations.rule: Stone House Reconstruction explicitly lets its owner renovate a clay house to stone "at any time" without placing a person, while paying the normal renovation cost. It is a direct no-worker action, though it does not grant Family Growth.

violations.quote: pays Food plus Clay whenever another player uses an improvement with printed clay cost.
violations.rule: Claypit Owner triggers each time another player "plays or builds an improvement with a printed clay cost." It does not trigger whenever another player uses an already-played improvement.

violations.quote: its immediate wood and Build Fences action support animal infrastructure without spending a normal Fencing placement
violations.rule: Animal Husbandry Worker grants the wood and Build Fences action only if there are exactly 3, 6, or 9 complete rounds left to play; these benefits are not unconditional when the Occupation is played.

violations.quote: giving that occupation's free Build Fences action and pasture-majority incentive an immediate animal target
violations.rule: Animal Husbandry Worker's Build Fences action is conditional on there being exactly 3, 6, or 9 complete rounds left to play. Its pasture-majority scoring text is unconditional, but its fence action is not.

violations.quote: Animal Husbandry Worker immediately grants a Build Fences action
violations.rule: Animal Husbandry Worker grants wood and a Build Fences action only if there are exactly 3, 6, or 9 complete rounds left to play; it does not always immediately grant that action.

violations.quote: Animal Husbandry Worker supplies an immediate fencing action
violations.rule: Animal Husbandry Worker grants the immediate Build Fences action only if there are exactly 3, 6, or 9 complete rounds left to play; it is not an unconditional immediate effect.

violations.quote: Animal Husbandry Worker grants a Build Fences action
violations.rule: The card's Build Fences action is conditional on there being 3, 6, or 9 complete rounds left to play.

violations.quote: Reed Belt supplies four timed reed for only 2 food
violations.rule: Reed Belt places Reed only on the remaining Round 5, 8, 10, and 12 spaces. It supplies all four only if played before Round 5; played later, it supplies fewer.

violations.quote: the crops and newborn animals generated by Fodder Planter
violations.rule: Fodder Planter does not generate newborn animals. In each breeding phase, for each newborn animal you get from breeding, it lets you sow crops in exactly 1 field.

violations.quote: the free fencing from Animal Husbandry Worker
violations.rule: Animal Husbandry Worker grants a "Build Fences" action only at its stated remaining-round thresholds; building fences still uses the normal fencing rules, including paying 1 Wood per fence.

violations.quote: Animal Husbandry Worker grants an immediate Build Fences action
violations.rule: This is conditional: it grants the wood and Build Fences action only if there are exactly 3, 6, or 9 complete rounds left to play.

violations.quote: without requiring a single contested action space
violations.rule: Omnifarmer is an Occupation. Occupations are played on a Lessons space, which holds one person and is therefore contested.

violations.quote: give Omnifarmer additional distinct harvested goods to bank
violations.rule: Omnifarmer may receive only a harvested crop or a newborn animal each harvest. Vegetables received from Large Greenhouse at the start of scheduled rounds are not harvested crops and cannot be placed on Omnifarmer on that basis.

violations.quote: while Fodder Planter can turn successful breeding into free sowing
violations.rule: Fodder Planter lets the player sow crops in exactly 1 field for each newborn animal, but it does not waive normal sowing requirements: sowing still requires a Grain or Vegetable seed from the player's personal supply.
